programme.desc: From cocoa to textiles and tech components, African manufacturers are taking steps to localize production while expanding their footprint across the continent; meeting the companies transforming raw materials into world-class products while keeping the value chain within the continent. (Documentary)

programme.title: African Voices - Mai Atafo
programme.desc: Nigerian luxury fashion designer Mai Atafo is the go-to designer for many of the country's celebrities and politicians; in Lagos, Atafo talks to Larry Madowo about his training in the traditions of London's Savile Row, widely considered the gold standard in tailoring; he discusses why he wanted to bring those standards to Africa. (Documentary, Biography)

programme.title: Marketplace Middle East - Tourism and the Arabian Travel Market
programme.desc: S1E57 - The war with Iran has sent shockwaves through one of the Middle East's most important industries: tourism; flights were cancelled, airspace closed and tens of thousands of travelers left stranded as bookings collapsed almost overnight; in Dubai alone, more than 80,000 bookings were cancelled in the first week of the war; consequently, travelers are increasingly looking beyond traditional Gulf destinations like Dubai and Doha, driving renewed tourism momentum in Tunisia. (News, Public affairs)

programme.title: Marketplace Africa - Namibia's Water Economy; Seyi Ebenezer
programme.desc: As the most arid country in sub-Saharan Africa, Namibia has always faced challenges when it comes to water resources; tech is now being deployed by everything from utility companies to farmers as a means of managing and conserving water while also cutting the costs of doing so; fintech companies continue to grow; we sit down with Seyi Ebenezer, the CEO of Payaza, a Pan-African fintech company, for a discussion. (Bus./financial, News)

programme.title: Africa Inc - South Africa's Film Industry
programme.desc: South Africa has become a major player in the global film industry, drawing Hollywood productions, streaming giants and billions in investment; Adefemi Akinsanya takes us inside Cape Town's booming production scene; visiting the studios where many big-budget international projects are created, and we talk to some of the people helping to power this economic engine. (News)

programme.title: Inside Africa - Madagascar's Island of Giants
programme.desc: Every year, humpback whales return to Sainte-Marie to mate, give birth and raise their young; following Cétamada president Dr. Anjara Saloma and a new generation of Malagasy researchers exploring their behaviour, while looking at the whales' wider place in the culture, livelihoods and identity of the island. - Isha Sesay (Travel)

programme.desc: S5E6 - Francois and Turbot learn an underwater volcano is going to erupt; Farmer Yumi and Mayor Goodway are scuba diving nearby; Farmer Al's farm is flooded. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.desc: S10E13 - Liberty and the Poms team up with the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay from being crushed by a giant, flying Top Hat. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Best of Skye
programme.desc: A storm causes Skye to crash-land in the snow; Mayor Humdinger plans to cheat; the Pups must save a stunt pilot and her plane; Smiley the frog jumps into Skye's helicopter; Walinda gets tangled in an anchor chain; Mayor Goodway's backpack slips. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Goldfish; Pups Save a Flying Florist
programme.desc: S12E11 - Uncle Otis accidentally slips and tosses Julia and Julius's new goldfish, Marigold, into the river! When Ms. Marjorie and Mr. Park don wingsuits to see a rare flower, a flying squirrel sends them off course! (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups and the Big Twin Trick; Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save the Mega Mayor
programme.desc: S6E18 - The Ladybird is up to her old tricks again, but this time the Mighty Twins have a super trick of their own; Mayor Humdinger finally gets superpowers, and it's a total cat-astrophe. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save Captain Crinkle-Cut/Pups Save the Big Nightlight
programme.desc: S11E24 - A french fry mascot needs help after being carried away by a flock of hungry seagulls; Mayor Humdinger tries to steal the Adventure Bay lighthouse. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Balloon Pups; Pups Save the Spider Spies
programme.desc: S6E16 - When giant balloons float away from a parade, it's up to the pups to save the pup balloons, the parade and Mayor Humdinger; the Turbot cousins try to spot a rare spider but get stuck in its web. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Squirrels; Pups Save a Roo
programme.desc: S6E20 - The PAW Patrol is on a roll when squirrels stash acorns in Alex's treehouse, causing it to fall onto Daring Danny's skateboard; a switcheroo situation develops when a joey is separated from its mother. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Mountain Surfers; Pups Save Humdinger's Home Away From Home
programme.desc: S11E7 - A mighty wind sweeps Zuma and Harrigan off the beach and blows them all the way up to Jake's Mountain; Humdinger's driving lands him and his trailer at the top of a tall spire. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Rocky Saves Himself; Pups and the Mystery of the Driverless Snowcat
programme.desc: S5E15 - Rocky must rescue himself after being stranded on an island full of trash by Mayor Humdinger; Daring Danny's new remote control accidentally takes control of Everest's SnoCat and all the vehicles in Adventure Bay. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Box Fort; Pups Save Travelin' Travis From Really Big Bill
programme.desc: S8E17 - The Pups must save Rocky and Humdinger from a runaway box fort; when Skye helps Traveling Travis search for Big Bill Island, the misguided explorer gets carried away by a really, really big bird. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Jungle Pups: Pups Save the Meerkat Pirates; Jungle Pups: Pups Save a Hum-Hippo
programme.desc: S10E7 - Arrby recruits a crew of meerkats to gather magical seeds; Mayor Humdinger wants a hippo as his new hench-animal, but needs a rescue when it gallops off with Humdinger on its back. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Go All Monkey; Pups Save a Hoot
programme.desc: S1E20 - An escaped monkey leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol saves a baby owl and reunites him with his mother. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Moon Rocks!
programme.desc: S1E7 - The Bubble Guppies learn about outer space. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Beach Ball!
programme.desc: S2E11 - Molly's friend needs the Guppies' help to finish her work in time to attend the Big Beach Ball. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Mountain Ninja Rescue
programme.desc: S6E8 - Ninjas Zooli and Oona are excited about their first mission: escorting snow monkey Moshi up Mt. Danger to join his troop; but it won't be easy: a storm looms, and mischievous Moshi is causing trouble. - Catherine Bradley, Caleb Clark, Leah Janvier, AJ Kane, Nirvaan Pal (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Team Umizoomi - Shooting Star
programme.desc: S3E6 - Shooting Star wants to be a big horse. (Children, Fantasy, Educational, Animated)

programme.title: Team Umizoomi - Gizmos Gone Wild!
programme.desc: S4E17 - The team must use their mighty math powers when a group of gizmo robots malfunction and wreak havoc at the Umi City Mall. (Children, Fantasy, Educational, Animated)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Bear-ly Save Danny; Pups Save the Mayor's Tulips
programme.desc: S3E16 - Daring Danny X is stuck in a tree over a deep canyon and pursued by hungry bears; Mayor Humdinger sabotages Mayor Goodway's perfect petals for the tulip contest. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ
programme.desc: S11E18 - Adventure Bay gets a fire station; when disaster strikes during the opening day BBQ, it's up to the PAW Patrol in their new fire rescue gear and vehicles to put it out. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Humsquatch; Pups Save a Far Flung Flying Disc
programme.desc: S6E22 - When Travelling Travis yelps for help when he finds a mysterious creature in trouble, the PAW Patrol heads to Foggy Bottom to save a Humsquatch; when a robo-toy causes mayhem in Adventure Bay, Ryder knows just who to call. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Gym
programme.desc: S2E7 - Coach Karima asks Rubble and Crew to build a gym for the gymnastics show but when the beam is too high for Lily, the pups must save the day; Rubble and Crew decide to build a show on their own when a traveling show can't get to Builder Cove. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Car Wash; The Crew Plans Grandpa Day
programme.desc: S1E5 - Mayor Greatway needs her muddy motorcycle cleaned fast, so Wheeler and the pups jump into action to build a solution before the big race; it's Grandpa Gravel's special day, but when the pups are needed, they have to change their Grandpa Day plans. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a High Flying Hen; Pups Save a Sloth
programme.desc: S10E2 - After Chickaletta accidentally takes flight on a toy airplane, it's up to the team to rescue her; Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey, racing to find it and cover up his blunder. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Chicken Conductor; Pups Save the Digi Tal Stylists
programme.desc: S11E16 - Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window; when Katie needs to close the Pet Parlor early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open. - Devan Cohen (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Sea Patrol: Pups Save Puplantis
programme.desc: S4E26 - Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate, Arrby, steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Baby Octopus
programme.desc: S4E13 - The Sea Patrol must save the day when a baby octopus gets separated from its mother and sinks the Flounder. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Parrot; Pups Save the Queen Bee
programme.desc: S2E12 - The PAW Patrol heads to the jungle to help their friend find his lost parrot; the PAW Patrol discovers a beehive in Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save Jake; Pups Save the Parade
programme.desc: S2E3 - The PAW Patrol must rescue Jake when his ankle gets stuck between some fallen rocks; when Alex puts too many balloons on Katie's bathtub float, it floats away. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - A Royal Mess
programme.desc: S5E3 - Dirty Deema steals Molly and Gil's soap and makes the Kingdom of Clean very dirty; Molly and Gil have to get their soap back and clean up the kingdom. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Taste Buddies!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Kingdom of Sleepwell!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The New Guppy!
programme.desc: S5E1 - The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Who's Gonna Play the Big Bad Wolf?
programme.desc: S1E8 - When an actor cannot perform at a play, Deema must take the stage. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Check It Out!
programme.desc: S2E10 - Gil and his friends dive into Gil's favorite books to find his missing library card. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Good Morning, Mr. Grumpfish!
programme.desc: S3E11 - The children try to teach Mr. Grumpfish about their favorite things when he is their substitute teacher. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - A Dolphin Is a Guppy's Best Friend!
programme.desc: S3E26 - Molly, Gil and the Guppies must lead a baby dolphin named Buddy to the surprise birthday party his pod is throwing for him. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Humunga-Truck!
programme.desc: S2E9 - The Guppies learn about different types of trucks while on their way to the Truck Show. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Bubble Bee-athalon!
programme.desc: S3E15 - The Guppies must work together to turn nectar into honey for the queen bee's tea time. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Glitter Games!
programme.desc: S4E1 - Molly helps a princess-in-training with her manners, and together they become princesses in the hallowed Glitter Games. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Fruit Camp!
programme.desc: S3E23 - Deema must turn over a new leaf and try broccoli if she wants to earn her broccoli badge at scout troop initiation. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Arctic Life!
programme.desc: S3E6 - Gil embarks on an icy expedition to the North Pole. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Something Fishy Going On!
programme.desc: S5E23 - Police Officers Molly and Gil are tracking some mysterious lights that have been popping up around town; with the help of several nocturnal animal friends, they discover the lights aren't aliens but anglerfish. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Super Potato Movie; TV Land; Bird Spotting; The Petting Farm; Goldie the Fish
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends visit the cinema; Peppa finds out how TV is made; Peppa and George go birdwatching; Peppa and friends visit a petting farm; Peppa takes Goldie the fish to visit Dr. Hamster the vet. - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Run Daddy Run; Coach Peppa; Marathon; Grownup Playground; Duck Race
programme.desc: Daddy Pig applies to the London Marathon; Peppa and George help Daddy Pig train for the marathon; Daddy Pig runs the London Marathon; Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa a tour around an exercise park. - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Mountain Climbing; Trampolines; Skateboarding; Hoops; Soft Play

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Long Grass; Dentist; Nature Trail; Rebecca Rabbit; School Bus Trip

programme.title: PAW Patrol - All Paws on Deck
programme.desc: S9E16 - Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem; Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
programme.desc: S13E1 - Before Chickaletta's play date with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap and gets stuck; Mayor Humdinger loses his voice. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Stadium Dome; The Crew Builds a Baggage Claim

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. - Russell Crowe, Karen Gillan, Marton Csokas, Thomas M. Wright, Harry Greenwood (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost. - Ben Affleck, Samuel L. Jackson, Toni Collette, Sydney Pollack, William Hurt (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Jo Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple). - Matthew McConaughey, Emile Hirsch, Juno Temple, Gina Gershon, Thomas Haden Church (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. - Brad Pitt, Morgan Freeman, Gwyneth Paltrow, R. Lee Ermey, Richard Roundtree (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Sweet Virginia
programme.desc: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. - Jon Bernthal, Christopher Abbott, Imogen Poots, Rosemarie DeWitt, Odessa Young (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Crimes of the Future
programme.desc: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs. Meanwhile, a mysterious group tries to use Saul's notoriety to shed light on the next phase of human evolution. - Viggo Mortensen, Léa Seydoux, Kristen Stewart, Scott Speedman, Welket Bungué (Horror, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Dutchman
programme.desc: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. - André Holland, Kate Mara, Zazie Beetz, Stephen McKinley Henderson, Aldis Hodge (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. - Elisabeth Shue, Michael Byrne, Phillip Noyce, Val Kilmer (Action)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. - Elizabeth Banks, Emily Browning, Arielle Kebbel, David Strathairn, Jesse Moss (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies. - Dan Aykroyd, Jane Curtin, Michelle Burke, Michael McKean, David Spade (Comedy, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. - Jordana Brewster, Clea DuVall, Laura Harris, Josh Hartnett, Shawn Hatosy (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. - Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey, D.J. Cotrona, Rick Cramer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. - Charles Esten, Oded Fehr, Brec Bassinger, Joel Johnstone, Lauren Call (Drama)

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. - Elisabeth Shue, Steven R McQueen, Adam Scott, Jerry O'Connell, Jessica Szohr (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: After 20 years away, Odysseus washes up on the shores of Ithaca. The king finds much has changed since he left to fight in the Trojan War. No longer the mighty warrior his people remember, Odysseus must face his past to save his family.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn baby home from the hospital. Realizing that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal experts and install numerous cameras to drive the spirit out.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When dictator Joseph Stalin dies, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

programme.title: What Women Want
programme.desc: A freak accident gives a Chicago advertising executive (Mel Gibson) the ability to read women's minds.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irving Zisman (Johnny Knoxville) takes his young and impressionable grandson (Jackson Nicoll) on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: Nitwits (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Chris Pontius) perform outrageous stunts and pull practical jokes on an unsuspecting public.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Georgina Cates, Greg Harris, Spike Jonze (Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy. (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull." (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself. - Maika Monroe, Keir Gilchrist, Daniel Zovatto, Jake Weary, Olivia Luccardi (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin, John Goodman, Victor Garber (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography)

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears. - Tom Cruise, Rosamund Pike, Robert Duvall, Richard Jenkins, Werner Herzog (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) springs into action after the arrest of Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), an Army major accused of treason. Suspecting foul play, Jack embarks on a mission to prove that the head of his old unit is innocent. After crossing paths with the law, Reacher must now go on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers. - Tom Cruise, Cobie Smulders, Aldis Hodge, Danika Yarosh, Patrick Heusinger (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Doctor Sleep
programme.desc: Struggling with alcoholism, Dan Torrance remains traumatized by the sinister events that occurred at the Overlook Hotel when he was a child. His hope for a peaceful existence soon becomes shattered when he meets Abra, a teen who shares his extrasensory gift of the "shine." Together, they form an unlikely alliance to battle the True Knot, a cult whose members try to feed off the shine of innocents to become immortal. - Ewan McGregor, Rebecca Ferguson, Kyliegh Curran, Cliff Curtis, Zahn McClarnon (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors. - Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea, John Hurt, Rupert Graves (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself. - Maika Monroe, Keir Gilchrist, Daniel Zovatto, Jake Weary, Olivia Luccardi (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. - Michael Douglas, Sharon Stone, George Dzundza, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Denis Arndt (Thriller)

programme.title: The Harvest
programme.desc: A physician (Samantha Morton) who keeps her dying son completely secluded becomes unhinged when she learns that her new neighbor (Natasha Calis) has secretly befriended the boy. - Samantha Morton, Michael Shannon, Natasha Calis, Charlie Tahan, Peter Fonda (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Phantoms
programme.desc: The resort town of Snowfield, Colo., is under attack by an evil spirit that almost wipes out the entire population, possessing a number of those it kills. As the locals continue to fall victim to the demonic presence, it's up to Sheriff Bryce Hammond (Ben Affleck) to lead the response. He's helped by FBI-employed academic Dr. Timothy Flyte (Peter O'Toole), Deputy Stu Wargle (Liev Schreiber), local doctor Jennifer Pailey (Joanna Going) and her visiting sister, Lisa (Rose McGowan). - Peter O'Toole, Rose McGowan, Joanna Going, Liev Schreiber, Ben Affleck (Horror)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher Jr., Douglas M. Griffin, Suzanne Cryer (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
programme.desc: In late 1920s Mexico, retired Gen. Gorostieta and his wife watch their country degenerate into violent civil war when the government enacts a series of anti-clerical laws. Gorostieta is at first hesitant to join the rebels, known as Cristeros, until he begins to see the cost of religious persecution on his countrymen. Though the odds are against him, the general nevertheless transforms a ragtag band of rebels into a formidable fighting force. - Andy Garcia, Eva Longoria, Peter O'Toole, Oscar Isaac, Santiago Cabrera (Historical drama)

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. - Haley Joel Osment, Jude Law, Frances O'Connor, Brendan Gleeson, Sam Robards (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Tale of the Mummy
programme.desc: Fifty years ago, Sir Richard Turkel (Christopher Lee) met disaster while exploring the supposedly cursed tomb of the ancient Egyptian tyrant Talos. Now his granddaughter, archaeologist Samantha Turkel (Louise Lombard), eagerly picks up where he left off, delving into its depths to uncover Talos' sarcophagus. But, shortly after the tomb's artifacts are transferred to a London museum, a strange series of murders begins to plague the city. Baffled local detectives enlist Samantha for help. - Jason Scott Lee, Louise Lombard, Sean Pertwee, Lysette Anthony, Michael Lerner (Horror)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource.

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey).

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Two hit men (John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson), a boxer, a crime boss and others meet their fates over the course of two days.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: A black bird resurrects a rock musician who then avenges his own murder and his fiancée's.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: Family and friends try to save a Hispanic teen who appears to be possessed by malevolent supernatural forces.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: An old and mysterious camcorder leads to the discovery of a supernatural terror in a family's new home.

programme.title: Rumpelstiltskin
programme.desc: A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul.

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: A ghost prompts a lethal battle of wills between a man's new fiancée and his two daughters, one of whom has just returned from a mental ward.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Picard (Patrick Stewart), Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and the others set off to stop the half-robot Borg from sabotaging the first warp drive flight in 2063.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler.

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: Secret agent James T. West (Will Smith) and his partner (Kevin Kline) fight evil inventor Dr. Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) who plans to assassinate President Grant.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: A publicity-seeking Chicago lawyer (Richard Gere) vies with an embittered ex-lover (Laura Linney) prosecuting an altar boy (Edward Norton) in a high-profile murder case.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Recurring nightmares of the planet Mars lead a confused earthling into the center of an intergalactic conspiracy.

programme.title: Hostage
programme.desc: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Sweet Virginia
programme.desc: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. - Jon Bernthal, Christopher Abbott, Imogen Poots, Rosemarie DeWitt, Odessa Young (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Prophecy
programme.desc: Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) has come to earth to strengthen his powers by claiming the wicked spirit of a psychotic veteran. The benevolent angel, Simon (Eric Stoltz), want to stop that from happening, so hides the man's spirit where Gabriel would least expect to find it: in a little girl (Moriah Shining Dove Snyder). Caught in a cosmic battle in which even Lucifer (Viggo Mortensen) plays a part, a liturgically minded cop (Elias Koteas) moves heaven and earth to protect the child. - Christopher Walken, Elias Koteas, Virginia Madsen, Eric Stoltz, Amanda Plummer (Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Prophecy IV: Uprising
programme.desc: A woman (Kari Wuhrer) must protect an ancient religious manuscript from renegade angels. - John Light, Sean Pertwee, Kari Wuhrer, Jason London, Doug Bradley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood. - Jojo Bapteise Whiting, LaDainian Crazy Thunder, Ashley Shelton, Robert Stover, Jesse Schmockel (Drama)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: We Baby Bears
programme.desc: After trying and failing to find a home while cast onto the streets of a city, the Baby Bears end up in a local playground in the middle of the night and wish on a star that they'd at least have a chance at finding a new home, no matter where in the universe it is. By some twist of fate the star falls from the sky and fuses with their box, turning it into a magical means of transportation to many worlds, from a village of talking vegetables to a land where snow sculptures come to life. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.desc: After trying and failing to find a home while cast onto the streets of a city, the Baby Bears end up in a local playground in the middle of the night and wish on a star that they'd at least have a chance at finding a new home, no matter where in the universe it is. By some twist of fate the star falls from the sky and fuses with their box, turning it into a magical means of transportation to many worlds, from a village of talking vegetables to a land where snow sculptures come to life. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Finn battles evil in the Land of Ooo; assisted by his magical dog, Jake, Finn roams the Land of Ooo righting wrongs and battling evil; usually that evil comes in the form of the Ice King, who is in search of a wife; he's decided he should wed Princess Bubblegum, though she doesn't want to marry him; still, he persists in trying to steal her away and Finn and Jake, along with Lady Raincorn do their best to keep her from harm. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: We Bare Bears
programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: Twenty years after Maria Rossi (Suzan Crowley) murdered three people, her daughter, Isabella (Fernanda Andrade), seeks the truth about that terrible night. Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. With the help of two young exorcists (Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth), Isabella tries to cure Maria -- and engages four demons in a battle for her mother's soul. - Fernanda Andrade, Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth, Suzan Crowley, Ionut Grama (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. - Mary J. Blige, Nat Wolff, David Zayas, Anika Noni Rose, Demetrius Grosse (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: For four years, Emily Taylor (Rooney Mara) has awaited the release of her husband, Martin (Channing Tatum), from being imprisoned for insider trading. Finally, Martin comes home, but Emily feels just as bad as she did when he was incarcerated, and she sinks into a deep depression. After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When those don't work, he gives Emily a new medication -- but the drug leads to ruined lives and death. - Jude Law, Rooney Mara, Channing Tatum, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Vinessa Shaw (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. - Matt Damon, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Cate Blanchett, Philip Seymour Hoffman (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Sliver
programme.desc: Well-to-do book editor Carly Norris (Sharon Stone) moves into a luxury apartment building before learning that a number of female tenants have been dying in grisly ways, allegedly at the hands of a serial killer. Soon, Norris becomes romantically involved with one of the prime suspects, building owner Zeke Hawkins (William Baldwin). The other suspect is her neighbor, writer Jack Landsford (Tom Berenger). Unsure of whom to trust, Norris must uncover the truth before she is the next victim. - Sharon Stone, William Baldwin, Tom Berenger, Polly Walker, Colleen Camp (Thriller)

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler. - Elisabeth Harnois, Morgan Kelly, Kimberly-Sue Murray, Thomas Mitchell, Victoria Sanchez (Thriller)

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. - Elias Koteas, Briana Middleton, Bridget Wareham, Justin Nurse, Reuben Frederick Gear (Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school. - Amanda Bynes, James Kirk, Channing Tatum, Laura Ramsey, Emily Perkins (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Our Ghosts
programme.desc: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. - Michele Riondino, Hadas Yaron, Paolo Pierobon, Orlando Forte, Alessandro Haber (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Hard Truths
programme.desc: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. - Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Michele Austin, David Webber, Tuwaine Barrett, Sophia Brown (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children. - Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger, Jack Nicholson, Jeff Daniels, Danny DeVito (Comedy drama)

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet. - Bowen Yang, Lily Gladstone, Kelly Marie Tran, Han Gi-chan, Bobo Le (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. - Mila Kunis, Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn, Cheryl Hines, Christine Baranski (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues. - Tommy Lee Jones, Ashley Judd, Bruce Greenwood, Annabeth Gish, Roma Maffia (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. - Kate Hallett, Herman Tømmeraas, Aya Furukawa, Justin Chatwin, Steven Ogg (Thriller)

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. - Channing Tatum, Alex Pettyfer, Matthew McConaughey, Cody Horn, Olivia Munn (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. - Channing Tatum, Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello, Kevin Nash, Adam Rodriguez (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Flypaper
programme.desc: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond).

programme.title: Urban Cowboy
programme.desc: A Texas farmer (John Travolta) moves to the city, immerses himself in honky-tonk and falls for a sexy cowgirl (Debra Winger).

programme.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
programme.desc: The unusual genetic makeup of a librarian (Eric Bana) causes him to travel back and forth through time, so that he and his beloved (Rachel McAdams) are always out of sync.

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: The wedding of their children and the arrival of a romantic prospect preoccupies bickering Minnesota retirees John (Jack Lemmon) and Max (Walter Matthau).

programme.title: A Perfect Murder
programme.desc: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

programme.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Michael and Madison Roland are a married couple; Michael Roland’s controlling behavior leads a pregnant Madison Roland to leave the home; she later discovers that her previous circumstances continue to affect her current life.

programme.title: Haunter
programme.desc: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: Married scientists (Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam) battle killer cockroaches that develop the ability to assume human form.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Investigating three faceless corpses, a detective (Bruno Campos) considers a teacher (Alix Koromzay) at an inner-city high school the prime suspect.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: Amy (Jena Malone), Stacy (Laura Ramsey), Jeff (Jonathan Tucker) and Eric (Shawn Ashmore) look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle. Carnivorous vines try to ensnare the friends in their tendrils, forcing the group to fight for survival. - Jonathan Tucker, Jena Malone, Laura Ramsey, Shawn Ashmore, Joe Anderson (Horror, Thriller, Adventure, Action, Mystery)

programme.title: Organ Trail
programme.desc: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits. - Zoé De Grand Maison, Nicholas Logan, Olivia Grace Applegate, Michael Abbott Jr., Jessica Frances Dukes (Western, Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Boudica: Queen of War
programme.desc: Roman conquerors slay King Prasutagus, take away his children, and force his wife, Boudica, into subservience. Consumed by grief and a burning desire for justice, Boudica vows to reclaim her homeland from the clutches of the Romans. She soon leads her army in a desperate assault as the fate of her people and her own destiny hang in the balance. - Olga Kurylenko, Clive Standen, Peter Franzén, Lucy Martin, Nick Moran (Historical drama, War, Action)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. - Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Christopher Barrie, Noah Taylor (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. - Nicole Kidman, Matthew Broderick, Bette Midler, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)

Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas.
