programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love. - Alex Pettyfer, Vanessa Hudgens, Neil Patrick Harris, Peter Krause, LisaGay Hamilton (Fantasy, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own. - Will Ferrell, Chris Kattan, Molly Shannon, Dan Hedaya, Loni Anderson (Comedy)

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart. - Julianne Hough, Diego Boneta, Russell Brand, Paul Giamatti, Catherine Zeta-Jones (Musical)

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go. - Marlon Wayans, Jaime Pressly, Essence Atkins, Gabriel Iglesias, Cedric the Entertainer (Comedy, Horror)

programme.title: King Kong
programme.desc: When a research ship is sent to explore an island thought to be rich in oil, paleontologist Jack Prescott sneaks aboard, having heard strange rumors about the island. En route, the crew rescues Dwan, the sole survivor of a shipwreck. When they arrive, they find native people living in fear of a monster called Kong. The natives kidnap Dwan and sacrifice her to what turns out to be an enormous ape. Dwan is eventually rescued, and the ape captured for a gala exhibit. - Jeff Bridges, Jessica Lange, Charles Grodin, John Randolph, Rene Auberjonois (Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. - Zachary Levi, Josh Duhamel, Quentin Plair, Terrence Terrell, Marshall Cook (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. - Robert Redford, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Lopez, Becca Gardner, Josh Lucas (Drama)

programme.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
programme.desc: In the long-running animated series' second feature film, the focus is on the show's perennial second banana, Chuckie (Christine Cavanaugh). Dads Stu (Jack Riley) and Chaz (Michael Bell) are unexpectedly sent to Euro-Reptarland in Paris, where the animatronic dinosaurs they built for the amusement park are malfunctioning, much to the displeasure of manager Coco La Bouche (Susan Sarandon). When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. - Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Michael Imperioli (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Spontaneous
programme.desc: When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last. As an unexpected romance blossoms between them, they soon discover that when tomorrow is no longer promised, they can finally start living for today. - Katherine Langford, Charlie Plummer, Yvonne Orji, Hayley Law, Rob Huebel (Dark comedy, Horror, Romance)

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition. - Vince Vaughn, Christine Taylor, Ben Stiller, Rip Torn, Justin Long (Comedy)

programme.title: Office Christmas Party
programme.desc: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

programme.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
programme.desc: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard.

programme.title: All the World Is Sleeping
programme.desc: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter.

programme.title: Daniela Forever
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Resurrected as a killer, a gas station owner terrorizes a group of teenagers (Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey) in the swamps of Louisiana.

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: A strange ritual soon unravels into a waking nightmare when a woman receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love.

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface.

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another. - Fionn O'Shea, Robert Aramayo, Erin Kellyman, Louis Hofmann, Jodi Balfour (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye. - Nicholas Hoult, Kevin Spacey, Sarah Paulson, Hope Davis, Victor Garber (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. - Tsemaye Bob-Egbe, Natey Jones, Jo Wheatley, Alexandra Burke, Michael Junior Onafowokan (Drama)

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara, Beverly D'Angelo, Ian Anthony Dale (Drama)

programme.title: NFL GameDay Live (Live)
programme.desc: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites. - Patrick Claybon (Sports talk, Football)

programme.title: SportsCenter (New)
programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms. (News, Sports talk)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott, Alison Doody, John Rhys-Davies (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Family, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. - Idris Elba, Matthew McConaughey, Tom Taylor, Claudia Kim, Fran Kranz (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: After his beloved father (Brian Dennehy) dies, dim-witted Tommy Callahan (Chris Farley) inherits a near-bankrupt automobile parts factory in Sandusky, Ohio. His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. - Chris Farley, David Spade, Brian Dennehy, Bo Derek, Dan Aykroyd (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. - Harrison Ford, Julia Ormond, Greg Kinnear, Nancy Marchand, John Wood (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Turtle Power: The Definitive History of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The release of Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird's groundbreaking comic in 1984 leads to a worldwide phenomenon. - Kevin Eastman, Barry Gordon, Cam Clarke, Townsend Coleman, James Avery (Children, Documentary)

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Love Means Zero
programme.desc: Tennis coach Nick Bollettieri's relentless desire to win at all costs leads to the destruction of an important relationship. (Documentary)

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: Elderly, angling and contentious friends Max (Walter Matthau) and John (Jack Lemmon) back-burner their bickering when their kids (Kevin Pollak, Daryl Hannah) get engaged, but fishing season opens a can of romantic worms as newcomer Maria (Sophia Loren) plans to turn their beloved bait shop into a restaurant. Botched matchmaking leads to some major romantic mix-ups, until an unexpected death in the family helps everyone realize that the most important thing in life is love. - Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Ann-Margret, Sophia Loren, Burgess Meredith (Comedy)

programme.title: Hey Arnold! The Movie
programme.desc: Arnold (Spencer Klein) and his pal, Gerald (Jamil Walker Smith), learn their beloved neighborhood is about to be torn down by a greedy developer named Scheck (Paul Sorvino) to build a mall. While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark, but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
programme.desc: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom. - Charlie Carter, Sarah Lawn, Jo Price, Matthew Wolf (Documentary)

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel. - Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Parker Posey, Greg Kinnear, Jean Stapleton (Drama, Romance, Comedy)

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Set in 1985, Adam Sandler plays a nice guy with a broken heart who's stuck in one of the most romantic jobs in the world, a wedding singer. He loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancé. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. Eventually, he falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married. - Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore, Christine Taylor, Allen Covert, Matthew Glave (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Training Day
programme.desc: Police drama about a veteran officer who escorts a rookie on his first day with the LAPD's tough inner-city narcotics unit. "Training Day" is a blistering action drama that asks the audience to decide what is necessary, what is heroic and what crosses the line in the harrowing gray zone of fighting urban crime. Does law-abiding law enforcement come at the expense of justice and public safety? If so, do we demand safe streets at any cost? - Denzel Washington, Ethan Hawke, Scott Glenn, Tom Berenger, Harris Yulin (Crime drama, Thriller)

Simmons) hot on his heels, Christian takes on a state-of-the-art robotics company as a legitimate client. As Wolff gets closer to the truth about a discrepancy that involves millions of dollars, the body count starts to rise. - Ben Affleck, Anna Kendrick, J.K. Simmons, Jon Bernthal, Jeffrey Tambor (Thriller, Action, Crime drama)

As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia. - Denzel Washington, Dakota Fanning, David Denman, Eugenio Mastrandrea, Gaia Scodellaro (Action, Thriller)

programme.desc: Kip and the family are headed to Kentucky for some early season whitetail heaven action; Kip's son, Cade, will be trying to get his first ever buck this week; after Kentucky, the Campbells head back to Virginia to put some homegrown bucks in neutral. (Hunting)

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler - Golden Slabs of Tobin Lake
programme.desc: S10E4 - Big walleye, new technology and plenty of action; Ryan takes on Tobin Lake and learns how forward-facing sonar can help put anglers on some truly giant fish. (Hunting, Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal TV - Muskies at Cliff
programme.desc: S8E10 - Cliff Lake in NW Ontario is home to some amazing muskie fishing, and we take a crack at them! (Outdoors)

programme.title: The One - Adrenaline pt1
programme.desc: S9E4 - Mike and his son are headed to Sask adrenaline on their annual trip to hunt black bears. Pt1. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Modern Hunter - The Techy Turkey Hunter
programme.desc: Dan is back in the spring woods, and this time he's putting modern gear to the test. He breaks down his favorite turkey shotguns, why TSS ammo hits harder and patterns tighter, and how mapping technology helps him lock in roost lines and more.

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries - Scott's Quest
programme.desc: S20E2 - The team returns to northwestern Oklahoma, where Yamaha's Scott Newby hopes for better conditions following a challenging hunt in Kentucky. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: CCFR Radio: On the Air
programme.desc: S6E1 - Join Rod Giltaca, from the CCFR, and guests in a firearm-related current events show. This Canadian podcast-style show explores topics about firearms and firearm rights! (Talk, Public affairs)

programme.title: Gettin Outdoors With Scott and Adelle - Perfectly Roasted Marshmallow
programme.desc: S2E1 - We start off season 2 with Hunter going after a gorgeous colour phase bear with his bow. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Lands of Nature - Africa - From Sea To Savanna
programme.desc: S1E2 - From the ocean to the savanna, Africa reveals an extraordinary diversity of landscapes and wildlife, where each ecosystem supports a unique and fascinating world. (Nature)

programme.title: Fishing the Wild West - Stockmen's Lodge
programme.desc: S10E2 - A Trip of a Lifetime to Stockmen's Lodge in Northern Saskatchewan. (Fishing)

programme.title: Guns & Gear - Workstations and Advanced Technologies
programme.desc: S16E2 - Real Avid launches the Workstation; Ruger introduces an American Gen II; B5 Systems, Caldwell and Ballistic Advantage show their newest innovations. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Dirt Trax Television - Rockin the Trail
programme.desc: S26E4 - AJ heads to Ontario's largest off-road event, Rockin the Trail while Mike and Luke share their thoughts on Yamaha's RMAX 4 XT-R. (Motorsports)

programme.title: 704 Outdoors - Wild Boar Redemption

programme.title: Hunt Warz - Illinois Archery Whitetail Deer Matchup: 2 of 3
programme.desc: The competition intensifies as two hunter athletes have filled their tags, although one hunter shot his buck late and had to back out and try to find his buck the next day. (Hunting)
